mapper.select: SELECT id, driver_id, fleet_id, shift_date, shift_type, starts_at, ends_at FROM driver_shift WHERE driver_id=#{driverId} AND shift_date=#{date}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM driver_shift WHERE driver_id=#{driverId} AND shift_date<>#{date} AND starts_at<#{end} AND ends_at>#{start})
SELECT shift_id,clock_in_at,clock_in_lat,clock_in_lon,clock_out_at,clock_out_lat,clock_out_lon FROM driver_attendance WHERE shift_id=#{shiftId}

SELECT a.shift_id,a.clock_in_at,a.clock_in_lat,a.clock_in_lon,a.clock_out_at,a.clock_out_lat,a.clock_out_lon FROM driver_attendance a JOIN driver_shift s ON s.id=a.shift_id WHERE s.driver_id=#{driverId} AND s.shift_date>=#{start} AND s.shift_date<#{end} ORDER BY s.shift_date
mapper.update: UPDATE driver_attendance SET clock_out_at=#{now},clock_out_lat=#{position.latitude}, clock_out_lon=#{position.longitude} WHERE shift_id=#{shiftId} AND clock_out_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM driver_shift s JOIN driver_attendance a ON a.shift_id=s.id WHERE s.driver_id=#{id} AND s.starts_at<=#{now} AND s.ends_at>#{now} AND a.clock_out_at IS NULL)

SELECT u.id,u.fleet_id,u.name,u.vehicle_id FROM sys_user u JOIN vehicle v ON v.id=u.vehicle_id AND v.fleet_id=u.fleet_id JOIN fleet f ON f.id=u.fleet_id AND f.enabled=1 WHERE u.role='DRIVER' AND u.enabled=1 AND (#{fleetId} IS NULL OR u.fleet_id=#{fleetId}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM driver_shift r WHERE r.driver_id=u.id AND r.shift_type='REST' AND r.shift_date=DATE(#{now})) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM driver_shift s JOIN driver_attendance a ON a.shift_id=s.id WHERE s.driver_id=u.id AND s.starts_at<=#{now} AND s.ends_at>#{now} AND a.clock_out_at IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM driver_leave l WHERE l.driver_id=u.id AND l.status='APPROVED' AND l.starts_at<=#{now} AND l.ends_at>#{now}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM transport_task t WHERE t.status='RUNNING' AND (t.driver_id=u.id OR t.vehicle_id=u.vehicle_id)) ORDER BY u.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
WHERE id=#{id}

WHERE (#{driverId} IS NULL OR driver_id=#{driverId}) AND (#{fleetId} IS NULL OR fleet_id=#{fleetId}) AND (#{status} IS NULL OR status=#{status}) AND (#{beforeId} IS NULL OR id<#{beforeId}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
WHERE driver_id=#{driverId} AND status='APPROVED' AND starts_at<#{end} AND ends_at>#{start} ORDER BY starts_at,id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM driver_leave WHERE driver_id=#{driverId} AND id<>#{exceptId} AND status='APPROVED' AND starts_at<#{end} AND ends_at>#{start})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM driver_leave WHERE driver_id=#{driverId} AND status='APPROVED' AND starts_at<=#{now} AND ends_at>#{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE driver_leave SET status=#{status},decided_by=#{admin},decided_at=#{now},decision_note=#{note} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM transport_task WHERE driver_id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING')
WHERE id=#{id}

WHERE (#{driverId} IS NULL OR driver_id=#{driverId}) AND (#{fleetId} IS NULL OR fleet_id=#{fleetId}) AND (#{status} IS NULL OR status=#{status}) AND (#{beforeId} IS NULL OR id<#{beforeId}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
WHERE driver_id=#{driverId} AND departed_at<#{end} AND COALESCE(ended_at,#{now})>#{start} ORDER BY departed_at,id

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM transport_task WHERE (driver_id=#{driverId} OR vehicle_id=#{vehicleId}) AND ((status='PENDING' AND starts_at<#{end} AND ends_at>#{start}) OR (status='RUNNING' AND COALESCE(departed_at,starts_at)<#{end} AND (ends_at>#{start} OR #{now}>#{start}))))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM transport_task WHERE status='RUNNING' AND id<>#{exceptId} AND (driver_id=#{driverId} OR vehicle_id=#{vehicleId}))
mapper.update: UPDATE transport_task SET status='RUNNING',departed_at=#{now},depart_lat=#{position.latitude}, depart_lon=#{position.longitude} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE transport_task SET status='COMPLETED',ended_at=#{now},end_lat=#{position.latitude}, end_lon=#{position.longitude} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE transport_task SET status='CANCELED',ended_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM driver_shift WHERE driver_id=#{driverId} AND shift_type='REST' AND shift_date>=DATE(#{start}) AND CAST(shift_date AS DATETIME)<#{end})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM driver_shift WHERE driver_id=#{driverId} AND shift_type IN ('EARLY','LATE') AND shift_date>=DATE(#{start}) - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND starts_at<#{end} AND ends_at>#{start})
WHERE created_by=#{actor} AND request_key=#{requestKey}
